advisory.finding: A new `detected_by` compiled-state field is introduced while a pre-existing, semantically distinct `detected_by:` TAG namespace already exists (bug-only has-tag auto-intersect). The two share the name `detected_by` but mean different things (detection-channel state field vs. tag filter convention), which invites confusion for readers and consumers querying tickets.
scenarios: A maintainer or consumer conflates the detection-channel field with the detected_by:* tag filter and queries/derives one expecting the other.

dropped.finding: Because link_core/revert_core/link_cli/_link_dry_run were moved to link_revert.py and only re-exported from composer, they resolve module globals (tracker_dir, resolve_ticket_id) in the link_revert namespace, not composer. Any monkeypatch that sets those globals on the composer module and then calls the re-exported function will silently NOT take effect. tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor.py still patches `composer.tracker_dir`, which is now vestigial for those functions.
scenarios: A future test or caller monkeypatches composer.resolve_ticket_id/tracker_dir and calls the re-exported composer.link_core expecting the patch to apply.
